If your two-year-old says "NO!" to everything, here's what's happening in her brain. 🧠

Rosie is two. "No!" "No!" "ME do it!" She empties every drawer. She melts down over the wrong cup. 😭

Rosie can't tell you what's going on, so let her teddy translate: 🧸
💬 "I want to do it myself."
💬 That small disappointment feels HUGE to her.
💬 She's exploring the world, not trying to ruin your day.
💬 She isn't waking up to give you a hard time. She's a brand new person, feeling everything for the first time.

And yes, your patience is running low. 🪫 So get quieter, not louder. These days feel long, but they won't last forever.

At sixteen, she won't reach up for your hand anymore. She's only two once. ❤️

When your patience runs out, His doesn't. "The LORD is merciful and gracious, slow to anger and abounding in steadfast love." Psalm 103:8 (ESV) 🙏 Jesus took our failures, and His way is still open to us.

You don't have to be a perfect mom. Her feelings are real, and so is your grace. ❤️ And big feelings don't disappear at three. Some kids carry them right into the school gate.
